div.p: KServe creates its emptyDir only if no volume named kserve-provision-location already exists on the pod.
Declaring one is how the chart substitutes a PVC.
Any other name and KServe adds its own emptyDir alongside: the PVC binds, stays empty, and the weights go to node disk.

div.h3: A PVC does not avoid the re-download
div.p: The storage-initializer writes into the target directory unconditionally — there is no skip-if-present for s3://. Every pod start re-downloads. Persistence changes where the bytes land, not whether they move.
What it buys: weights off node ephemeral storage (no eviction, no contention with co-scheduled pods), and models larger than the node's disk become possible at all.
To download once: pre-populate a volume and use modelUri: pvc://...
